scope: Strict 10 Shapes & Geometry Functions Whitelist Boundary

tasks.title: Audit, Purge Non-Whitelisted Shape Methods & Enforce 10-Function API Boundary
tasks.description: Audit src/managers/ShapeManager.js, src/core/PPTXTemplater.js, and index.d.ts. Purge any shapes and geometry methods outside the exact 10-method whitelist (e.g., deleteShape, updateShapeText, alignShapes, validateShape, addTextAtPosition). Ensure that only the 10 approved methods exist across runtime delegates, interfaces, and public classes.

tasks.title: Implement Shape Creation, Cloning, Update & Deletion Operations
tasks.description: Implement and verify addShape, updateShape, removeShape, clearShapes, and cloneShape in ShapeManager. Handle OpenXML DrawingML shapes (<p:sp>), coordinate transformations (<a:xfrm>), preset geometries (<a:prstGeom>), fills, lines, and text frames (<p:txBody>). Ensure percentage-to-EMU conversions, maintain fluent method chaining returning 'this', and ensure clearShapes evacuates shapes while retaining layout placeholders.

tasks.title: Implement Grouping & Ungrouping Subsystem
tasks.description: Implement groupShapes, ungroupShapes, and getGroupShapes. Build composite group containers (<p:grpSp>) under <p:spTree>, calculate composite bounding boxes (<p:grpSpPr> with <a:xfrm> and child offset <a:chOff>/<a:chExt>), handle child unnesting with coordinate re-projection back to canvas absolute EMUs, and return child shape descriptors.

tasks.title: Implement Shape Inspection & Metadata Querying
tasks.description: Implement getShapes and getShape in ShapeManager and PPTXTemplater. Inspect DrawingML nodes (<p:sp>, <p:grpSp>) to return normalized shape descriptors including ID, name, geometry type, coordinate bounds (x, y, width, height in pixels and EMUs), style metadata (fill, stroke, rotation), and inner text.

tasks.title: Build Executable Showcase Script (showcase/shapes_geometry.js)
tasks.description: Create showcase/shapes_geometry.js executing every single one of the 10 approved Shape & Geometry methods. Provide comprehensive JSDoc headers, explanatory inline comments, and informative console.log statements covering all shape, styling, grouping, and clone features.

tasks.title: Documentation, Metadata & .agent Knowledge Base Sync
tasks.description: Update docs-site/src/data/apiReference.json under 'Shapes & Geometry' to document exclusively the 10 approved methods with signatures, parameters, return types, and copyable examples. Purge removed methods from docs-site/src/data/features.json and README.md, and sync .agent/rules/features.md and .agent/project_summary.md.
